talents.e: Wrath casts faster and costs half as much mana.
Raises periodic damage and healing from your spells by 5%.
Cuts the mana cost of damaging spells by a quarter.
Moonfire deals more damage and crits more often, up to 10%.
Raises spell and melee critical strike chance by 4%.
Extends offensive Balance spell range by 20% and adds 4% hit.
Roots deal 75% more damage and tolerate more damage before breaking.
Lengthens Moonfire, Rejuvenation, Regrowth and Insect Swarm durations.
Lowers the target's attack hit chance by 2% and deals Nature damage over time.
Arcane and Nature spell critical damage bonus rises by 100%.
Starfire casts faster and has a 15% chance to stun.
Entangling Roots can affect two additional enemies at once.
Non-periodic spell crits speed casting and cut global cooldown by 10%.
Wrath stores charges that shorten your next Starfires' cast times.
Arcane and Nature spell damage increases by 10%.
Moonkin Form boosts crit aura, item armor and Omen procs, but blocks healing.
Cuts energy or rage costs of several attacks by up to 5.
Boosts Intellect, plus bear Stamina and cat Strength.
Cat Form movement speed rises 30% and dodge rises 4%.
Swipe deals more damage and prowling stealth detection is weaker.
Bash and Pounce stun longer, and Bash cooldown drops by 30 seconds.
Several forms grant more base armor scaling with level and defense.
Shred costs less energy and Lacerate costs less rage.
Claw, Rake, Shred, Maul and Swipe deal 10% more damage.
Bear Form charge stuns and interrupts, and can leap behind the target.
Critical strike chance rises 6% in bear and cat forms.
Melee attack power in cat and bear forms rises by 150% of level.
Bear crits grant rage more often, and cat combo crits add a point.
Converts a large chunk of base mana into 40 energy on a cooldown.
Melee bite that deals extra damage and generates heavy threat.
Shifting Power cooldown drops by 8 seconds.
Party critical strike chance rises 3% in cat or bear forms.
Melee critical damage bonus rises 20%, and spell healing scales with Intellect.
Dodge chance rises 5%, and each dodge can grant rage.
Melee damage against bleeding targets rises by 10%.
Primal Bite hits three targets, grants fear immunity and boosts combo crits.
Arcane and Nature casts resist damage interruption 70% of the time.
Shapeshifting restores rage or energy, with stronger chances and amounts.
Healing Touch casts faster and all your damage rises 5%.
Nature and Arcane spells generate 30% less threat.
Shapeshifting costs 30% less mana.
Keeps 50% of mana regeneration active while casting.
All your healing spells become 10% stronger.
Rejuvenation, Swiftmend and Wild Growth global cooldown drops by half a second.
Healing Touch and Tranquility cost 10% less mana.
Rejuvenation heals 15% more.
Instantly heals a Rejuvenation or Regrowth target for that effect's full periodic amount.
Your next Nature spell becomes instant, on a three-minute cooldown.
Spirit rises by 15%.
Eliminates Tranquility threat and cuts its cooldown by 60%.
Regrowth critical effect chance rises by 50%.
Heals the target and nearby party members over seven seconds.
